u0: Rest/final state (initial and the only final state in the machine, but not an episode end): the siren is off, no client is waiting, and no fall recovery is pending. Hands may be empty or holding a portion. Monitor for a new client, a new ring, or a food slip; when one occurs, switch to the corresponding handling or recovery task. If already holding food, keep it for the next order.
u1: Siren-only obligation: the siren is ringing and no client is waiting. Go to the siren switch, face it, and toggle it off. If carrying food, keep hold of it; if a client arrives while the ring is still active, both the ring and order handling become active.
u10: Immediate post-fall recovery with an order taken, siren off, and hands empty; the slipped food is raw/unprepared. Pick it up on the very next move. If recovered, go to the stove and prepare it; if not, the missed recovery is penalized and the waiting order continues without food in hand.
u11: Immediate post-fall recovery with an order taken, siren ringing, and hands empty; the slipped food is raw/unprepared. The very next move must be to pick it up, not to toggle the switch. After recovery, silence the siren, then prepare and serve the food.
u12: Immediate post-fall recovery with an order taken, siren off, and hands empty; the slipped food is already prepared. Pick it up on the very next move. A recovered prepared portion can go directly to the client; a failed recovery is penalized and leaves the order needing food again.
u13: Immediate post-fall recovery with an order taken, siren ringing, and hands empty; the slipped food is already prepared. Recover it on the very next move, then serve it and silence the siren. Do not use this step for the switch.
u14: Immediate post-fall recovery with a client waiting, order untaken, siren off, and hands empty. Pick the fallen food up on the very next move. If recovered, resume by taking the client's order and then fetching/preparing/serving; a failed recovery is penalized and the client work continues.
u15: Immediate post-fall recovery with a client waiting, order untaken, siren ringing, and hands empty. Pick the fallen food up on the very next move; do not switch the siren instead. Once recovered, silence the siren and take the order.
u16: Immediate post-fall recovery with no client waiting, siren off, and hands empty. Pick the fallen food up on the very next move; successful recovery returns to the resting state (or to siren handling if a ring starts). A failed recovery is penalized, and a client arriving now merges into the normal client task.
u17: Immediate post-fall recovery with no client waiting, siren ringing, and hands empty. Pick the fallen food up on the very next move before dealing with the siren; then go silence the switch. A failed recovery is penalized and leaves the siren obligation active.
u2: Client order pending: a client is waiting, the siren is off, and the order has not been taken. Go to the counter, face the client, and toggle to take the order. Hands may be empty or already holding raw food; after taking the order, fetch food if empty or go prepare it if carrying. If the siren starts or food slips, handle that immediately.
u3: Client and siren both pending: a client is waiting, the order is untaken, and the siren is ringing. The preferred next objective is to silence the siren first, then return to the client and take the order. If food slips before the order is taken, recover it on the next move.
u4: Order taken, client waiting, siren off, hands empty. Fetch a portion from the pantry: face the pantry and pick up. Then take the raw food to the stove to prepare. If the siren starts, switch to handling both the ring and the food run.
u5: Order taken, client waiting, siren ringing, hands empty. Silence the siren first by toggling its switch; then fetch food from the pantry. After pickup the task becomes carrying raw food while the client still needs preparation and service.
u6: Order taken, client waiting, siren off, and raw food is in hand. Go to the stove, face it, and toggle to prepare the food. Keep the portion; if it slips, the next move must recover it. Once green, head to the client to serve.
u7: Order taken, client waiting, siren ringing, and raw food is in hand. Silence the siren and prepare the food; preferred order is to switch the siren off first, then go to the stove. If the food slips, recover it on the very next move.
u8: Order taken, client waiting, siren off, and prepared food is in hand. Take it to the client, face the client, and toggle to serve. If the siren starts, the state becomes a combined serve-and-silence task; if the food slips, recover it immediately.
u9: Order taken, client waiting, siren ringing, and prepared food is in hand. Both serving and silencing remain. The preferred objective is to switch the siren off first, then serve the prepared food; serving first is allowed but leaves the siren obligation for immediately afterward. Recover any slip on the very next move.
